contract: A Journey navigates between rendered screens within one Activity. Prepare a destination behind the outgoing screen before its dismissal checkpoint. Retain the outgoing screen on preparation failure or cancellation; unused destination resources drain before their artifact lease is released. Authored transition timing and checkpoint cancellation reconciliation require additional qualification.

checkpointRetry.contract: A cancelled waiter does not cancel an admitted dismissal checkpoint. Retry of the same destination joins its result; a different destination is superseded rather than reusing the original checkpoint.

transparentPreparation.contract: A provisional destination remains invisible through transparent outgoing content until activation. Native preparation completes while the destination is hidden.

terminalCheckpoint.contract: Host dismissal and identity shutdown drain an admitted navigation checkpoint, then their terminal outcome. Cancellation of the navigation waiter does not change this. A later navigation retirement cannot complete an earlier terminal owner. No destination launches after withdrawal.
